items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I used to have to send these into the librarian, and her name I'll never forget. Helen Keppler. She would even call me in and I used to have to send the programs in by the week

ctx.x: Oh yes. We would have to rehearse because I used to have to turn my programs in to WBBM, you know, a week in advance to have them cleared, you know, like what were the original things and the tunes that couldn't be broadcast at that time, and I would make arrangements, you know, musical arrangements. This is for the band, and we would have to rehearse so they would be pretty clean on the air, you know, and we got a chance to rehearse quite a bit by broadcasting three or four times a week, you know, you have to…
